JILONG Mini Optical Power Meter OPM-22V – High-Precision Fiber Optic Testing Tool

Compact, Multi-Function Optical Power Meter with VFL & Cable Tester

The JILONG OPM-22V Mini Optical Power Meter is a pocket-sized, high-precision fiber optic testing device designed for FTTH, fiber network maintenance, and telecom applications. This all-in-one optical tester features an integrated Visual Fault Locator (VFL) with 10mW output, an accurate power measurement range of -50 to +26 dBm, and network UTP cable testing for CAT5e & CAT6 cables.


With a universal FC/SC/ST adapter, rechargeable lithium battery, and USB charging, the JILONG OPM-22V is an essential tool for fiber optic professionals, offering high accuracy (±0.2 dB) and a wide wavelength range (850-1625nm).


Key Features 

  • Ultra-Portable Design – Pocket-sized for convenient fiber optic testing on the go.
  • Multi-Function Tester – Optical Power Meter, Visual Fault Locator (VFL), and UTP Cable Tester in one device.
  • Visual Fault Locator (VFL) 10mW – Detects breaks, bends, and weak signals in fiber optic cables.
  • Accurate Measurement – ±0.2 dB precision for high-reliability testing.
  • Wide Power Range – -50 ~ +26 dBm for diverse fiber network applications.
  • Supports Multiple Wavelengths – 850/ 980/ 1300/ 1310/ 1490/ 1550/ 1625 nm for versatile use.
  • Network UTP Cable Testing – Compatible with CAT5e & CAT6 cables for additional network diagnostics.
  • Built-in LED Light – Provides illumination for working in dark environments.
  • Universal FC/SC/ST Adapter – Ensures compatibility with a wide range of fiber connectors.
  • Rechargeable Lithium Battery – USB-charging for extended battery life and convenience.
  • Durable & Long-Lasting – 3-Year Warranty Support for peace of mind.


Technical Specifications

  • Model: JILONG OPM-22V
  • Optical Power Range: -50 ~ +26 dBm
  • Wavelength Support: 850/980/1300/1310/1490/1550/1625 nm
  • Measurement Accuracy: ±0.2 dB
  • Visual Fault Locator (VFL) Power: 10mW
  • UTP Cable Test: Supports CAT5e & CAT6
  • Connector Compatibility: FC/SC/ST Universal Adapter
  • Battery Type: Rechargeable Lithium Battery (USB charging)
  • Additional Features: Built-in LED light for dark environments
  • Warranty: 3 Years


Ideal Applications

  • FTTH Installation & Maintenance – Ensures precise fiber optic signal measurement.
  • Telecom & ISP Networks – Diagnose network issues with high accuracy.
  • Enterprise & Data Center Networking – Maintain fiber connections with ease.
  • Network Engineers & Technicians – Essential tool for field and lab testing.
  • UTP Cable Testing – Verify CAT5e & CAT6 network cables for proper functionality.


Why Choose the JILONG Mini Optical Power Meter OPM-22V?

  • All-in-One Fiber Testing Tool – Optical Power Meter + VFL + UTP Tester
  • Accurate & Reliable – ±0.2 dB measurement accuracy with wide wavelength range
  • Portable & Convenient – Compact size, built-in LED, and USB rechargeable battery
  • Long-Lasting Performance – 3-Year Warranty for durability and support
  • Universal Compatibility – Works with FC/SC/ST connectors for easy testing
